newsitem.title: USA: Today's Man seeks extension of exclusivity.
newsitem.headline: Today's Man seeks extension of exclusivity.

text.p: Today's Man Inc said Wednesday it filed a motion to extend for three weeks its exclusivity period to file a plan to reorganize.

The company said it filed the motion with the consent and support of its official creditor's committee. The motion would extend the June 2, 1997 exclusive period for the company to file a plan of reorganization to June 24, 1997.
With the support of the committee, the company expects rapid court approval of the motion, it said.
The clothing store company filed for bankruptcy protection February 2, 1996.
